description: This file contains test scripts written in shell, designed to test Git hook behavior and push operations, including handling of missing hooks and atomic push failures.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with certain Git operations, including failure scenarios.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expected to fail, signaling test failure if the command succeeds.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes command output to a stable, user-friendly format for comparisons.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Saves an expected output block for verification in tests.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output to expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares Git references against expected references.

calls: git -C workbench push --atomic origin $B:main HEAD:next HEAD:refs/for/main/topic
